name: evidence-first-scholar-assessment
description: DORA-informed, evidence-first assessment of an academic's research quality, scholarly influence, trajectory, contribution, robustness, and peer context.

interface.longDescription: Assess an academic's research quality and scholarly influence through identity-validated evidence, output-level reading, responsible metrics, contribution attribution, matched-peer context, uncertainty analysis, and auditable reporting. Designed for promotion, tenure, senior appointments, chair-professorship review, and due diligence. Quantitative indicators support rather than replace qualitative judgment; journal prestige, titles, and raw profile totals are not treated as automatic evidence of quality.
defaultPrompt: Assess this scholar's research quality and impact using an evidence-first, DORA-informed approach.
Audit this academic profile for identity errors, metric limitations, and unsupported impact claims.
Create an auditable senior-appointment research assessment with matched-peer context.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only release with a DORA-informed assessment workflow, report template, case scaffolding, metric calculation, and validation helpers.
